sum_of(xs: List[int]) -> int =
  post out >= 0 or xs.len() > 0
  ex sum_of([1, 2, 3]) == 6
  var t = 0
  for x in xs
    t += x
  t

bump_all(var xs: List[int], by: int) -> int =
  pre by >= 0
  post out == xs.len()
  ex bump_all([1, 2, 3], 10) == 3
  var n = 0
  for var x in xs
    x += by
    n += 1
  n
